verdict.rationale: Sub-accounts with automatic allocation of incoming deposits are a fair question for a business banking and payments account, so the axis applies. The pack only documents multi-currency balances (hold and convert in up to 56 currencies). That is an adjacent feature: it shows neither multiple checking sub-accounts within one currency nor any rule-based routing of incoming deposits across them.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them
